beats.care: Better data means better policy for gig workers like delivery riders, and recognition for the work your mom does at home.
beats.what: The Statistics Ministry will change the Periodic Labour Force Survey from January 2027.
beats.why: It will find homes with at least one gig worker and ask about cooking, cleaning, childcare and elder care, work mostly done by women and never counted before.

cards.body: The survey will also capture volunteer and trainee work, and new questions on 'labour underutilisation', people who want more work than they get. Public comments are open for 15 days.
Housework and caregiving let others go out and earn. If it isn't measured, it's invisible in policy and in GDP debates.

opts: Count it, but not in GDP

cards.why: A separate sampling layer will identify homes with at least one digital platform worker.

hook: India will finally count *gig workers* and unpaid housework in jobs data

learn.t: The PLFS, run by the NSSO since 2017, is India's main source of data on jobs and unemployment.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Govt. to revise labour survey to track gig, household work (print, Hyderabad edition, 24 Oct, p.10)

tldr: The national labour survey will track delivery and app-based workers, and measure unpaid household and care work, from January 2027.
watch: The new design starts in January 2027. Watch for the first numbers on how many Indians do gig work.
